install_method: ciel (installs <PDK_ROOT>/ciel/sky130/versions/<open_pdks commit>/sky130A, linked as <PDK_ROOT>/sky130A); open_pdks or a direct checkout at the same commit is equivalent
revision_discovery: resolved path component after /versions/, else the 'open_pdks <commit>' line of <variant dir>/SOURCES
notes: Pin is the open_pdks commit, not the ciel bundle hash. Both are the same value for this install (ciel names versions by open_pdks commit); confirmed against <variant dir>/SOURCES.
